component.name: TM5 for Linux
component.summary: Test RAM stability with TestMem5 configs

description.p: TM5 for Linux is a memory stability tester modelled on TestMem5 (TM5). It reads TM5 config files directly and comes with the popular Extreme1 profile by anta777, so you can check memory overclocks and new RAM on Linux the same way you would on Windows.

ul.li: Runs the TM5 test functions (SimpleTest, MirrorMove, MirrorMove128, RefreshStable) on every CPU thread at once
Locks the tested memory in RAM and bypasses CPU caches so the DRAM itself is tested
Plain-language explanations of every test and every error
Live progress, time remaining, speed and a TM5-style test sequence view
CPU temperature, and RAM temperature on modules with a sensor
Also usable from the terminal with tm5linux-cli
